title: An exceptional guide, with a lot of knowledge of the Alhambra.
text: It was a fantastic experience and the guide was wonderful; he explained everything we were seeing and many more things about the history of the Alhambra, Granada, and Andalusia.
author: Elisa_P

title: Totally worth it
text: Great tour, our guide was excellent, he was friendly and knowledgeable. My mom and I has an amazing experience.
author: Susana_S

title: Unforgetable!
text: Memorable and amazing experience. Still processing all the insights and history our guide Hector shared with us over a personalized masterclass during our 3 hour tour
author: Juan_S

title: 100% Recommend
text: Incredible!!!  Roberto was amazing g and I can’t express enough about the depth of his knowledge of the buildings and history. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone. He is pleasant, courteous and passionate about the tour.
author: Jeffrey_P

title: Fantastic enthusiasm and knowledge
text:
We had Roberto as our guide and he was fantastic.
Make sure to book early if at all possible so that you can get tickets to the Nasirid Palaces
author: Julian_Y

title: Andalusia Passion.
text: Roberto is a brilliant guy, he speaks Italian fluently. We booked the Granada tour and he proved to be very knowledgeable, capable of conveying his passion for his city to us. He satisfied all our curiosity and gave us useful tips to continue our tour. We requested the Alhambra tour at the last minute and he was impeccable there too. Highly recommended.
author: inessQ8358CW

title: Detailed and interesting information about Alhambra
text: My wife and I visited Granada September 26 having never been before. Roberto was first to respond to our request for a private tour of the Alhambra, Nasrid Palaces and other interests nearby. His advice was clear, clinical, concise and affordable so we went for it. He arranged the tickets, meeting place and everything else satisfactorily and we had an exceptional tour for 3 and 1/2 hours. His English was also impeccable and impressive and his knowledge and passion of Granada and indeed the Alhambra well grounded. We will be considering his services on further visits to Spain in the coming year
author: johnsB10KS

title: Excellent guide and tour
text: Hector was a wonderfully knowledgeable and passionate guide. His background in art, history especially the Alhambra was helpful in answering questions and telling the history of the fortress/palace throughout the ages. He was respectful of my pace and didn’t rush, and navigated through the crowds very well to get me in the perfect spot to view and take in this UNESCO World Heritage site.
author: Mary_S

title: Beautiful experience
text: A kind, knowledgeable young man, with thorough and interesting explanations.  Great recommendations for dinner as well
author: Casagrignani

title: Hector is a fantastic guide!
text: Hector is a first-class guide to the Alhambra! He is particularly suited for this tour and others in Granada, as he is fluent and very knowledgeable in both Spanish and Arabic, art history, and culture. We really enjoyed Hector's tour in perfect English (he also speaks Italian), and we have no hesitation in recommending him.
author: Paula_R
